mechanism: Test every raw coefficient in each planned quartet for exact equality, then submit one prepared sum index instead of four raw indices. Other raw terms enter ordinary exact classification.
qualify: Ordinary vs frozen must calibrate within 2% per input. An early mode needs a lower paired median and at least six of eight wins on both inputs against frozen, ordinary, its same-build late mode and the matching exact prior SDK. To prefer the joint early mode it must also clear early B2 by that margin.
routes: Separate traced captures compare builds, old exact class counts, new four-equal counts and hash input sizes against the archived captures. Negative tests deny optional memory or provide an invalid K plan while B2 remains valid.
